```{r}
report_target_store <- Sys.getenv("TRANSPLANT_TARGET_STORE", "_targets")
if (!grepl("^/", report_target_store)) {
  report_target_store <- file.path(here::here(), report_target_store)
}
report_target_store <- normalizePath(report_target_store, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
report_target_config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
targets::tar_config_set(store = report_target_store, config = report_target_config)
Sys.setenv(TAR_CONFIG = report_target_config)
```

## Inputs, configuration, and scope


### Purpose

Document configured sources, experiment scope, and frozen input-snapshot checks.

### Inputs

`config/analysis.R`, the configured network source, and the experiment registry.

### Decisions and exclusions

This stage inventories sources and defines scope; it makes no resident-model species exclusions.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
cfg <- targets::tar_read(config)
inventory <- targets::tar_read(input_inventory)
sources <- targets::tar_read(active_source_inventory)
validation <- targets::tar_read(community_validation)
experiments <- targets::tar_read(experiments)
cat("Configured network input:", cfg$input_rdata, "\n\n")
cat("Analysis experiments:", nrow(experiments), "\n\n")
knitr::kable(inventory)
knitr::kable(validation)
knitr::kable(
  sources |>
    dplyr::count(.data$source_role, name = "files") |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$source_role)
)
knitr::kable(sources)
```

### Problems flagged

Missing sources, invalid experiment identifiers, or failed input-snapshot checks stop the target.

### Principal outputs

`input_inventory`, `experiments`, `community_validation`, and
`active_source_inventory`.

### PASS/FAIL

The report is produced only after the current input and experiment targets succeed.
## Community import and cleaning


### Purpose

Summarize the network adapter, reviewed local mapping, and standardized community.

### Inputs

Network community objects, site/experiment metadata, and reviewed species mapping decisions.

### Decisions and exclusions

Only reviewed mapping rules are applied. No six-species resident-model exclusion occurs here.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
sites <- targets::tar_read(sites)
experiments <- targets::tar_read(experiments)
community <- targets::tar_read(community)
mapping_review <- targets::tar_read(species_mapping_review)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  object = c("sites", "experiments", "community rows", "mapped species keys"),
  n = c(nrow(sites), nrow(experiments), nrow(community), nrow(mapping_review))
))
```

### Problems flagged

Non-unique mappings, missing identifiers, or failed community-interface checks stop construction.

### Principal outputs

`sites`, `experiments`, `species_mapping`, and `community`.

### PASS/FAIL

Canonical construction and mapping-review validation must complete before rendering.
## Taxonomic harmonization


### Purpose

Document TNRS decisions and the species-resolution gate.

### Inputs

Canonical community names, TNRS responses, and reviewed taxonomy override files.

### Decisions and exclusions

Reviewed accepted names remain authoritative; non-species records are explicitly marked rather than silently coerced.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
review <- targets::tar_read(community_taxonomy_review)
resolution <- targets::tar_read(vegetation_taxonomic_resolution)
species <- targets::tar_read(community_taxonomy_species)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  metric = c("TNRS review rows", "resolution decisions", "included species-level names",
             "omitted non-species names"),
  value = c(nrow(review), nrow(resolution), nrow(species),
            sum(!resolution$include_species_level))
))
```

### Problems flagged

Unreviewed ambiguous matches, duplicated accepted names, and incomplete required taxonomy are release failures.

### Principal outputs

`community_taxonomy_review`, `vegetation_taxonomic_resolution`, and `community_taxonomy_species`.

### PASS/FAIL

Only reviewed species-level or infraspecific taxa enter the analysis community.
## Climate covariates


### Purpose

Report the CHELSA coordinate audit and experiment-level coverage.

### Inputs

Validated site coordinates, experiment years, and the resumable CHELSA cache.

### Decisions and exclusions

Coordinate checks precede extraction. Missing source days or years remain visible as coverage flags.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
audit <- targets::tar_read(chelsa_coordinate_audit)
coverage <- targets::tar_read(experiment_climate_coverage)
knitr::kable(audit$summary)
knitr::kable(coverage[, c("experiment_id", "climate_complete", "climate_summary_status")])
```

### Problems flagged

Invalid coordinates and incomplete experiment climate are reported explicitly.

### Principal outputs

`site_year_climate`, `experiment_climate`, `chelsa_coordinate_audit`, and `experiment_climate_coverage`.

### PASS/FAIL

Coordinates are validated before extraction; incomplete years remain explicitly flagged.
## Trait preparation


### Purpose

Summarize TRY filtering, range checks, and species-level trait availability.

### Inputs

TRY source data, trait dictionary, TNRS mapping, range rules, and climate-zone filters.

### Decisions and exclusions

Approved traits, units, taxonomic matches, and biological ranges are applied before species summaries.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
filter_audit <- targets::tar_read(try_climate_filtered)$audit
range_validation <- targets::tar_read(try_range_validation)
traits <- targets::tar_read(try_trait_outputs)$summary
knitr::kable(filter_audit)
knitr::kable(range_validation)
knitr::kable(data.frame(species_trait_rows = nrow(traits)))
```

### Problems flagged

Rejected units, out-of-range observations, taxonomic gaps, and missing species summaries remain in audit targets.

### Principal outputs

`try_cleaned`, `try_range_validation`, and `try_trait_outputs`.

### PASS/FAIL

Trait summaries are built only from approved traits, units, taxonomy, and climate zones.
